{{Quote|Death to the Baroness!|The Senate Guard|<ref name="Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 1">[[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 1|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'' 1]]</ref>}}
An [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as a member of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] in [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]]. When [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Omnino]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vena]] came to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on a diplomatic visit, she used a [[mind control device]] on the Senate Guard as part of a scheme to discredit the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and eat some [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]]. The Senate Guard shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Omnino's [[Omnino's bodyguard|bodyguard]] and was then chased by Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. He fell to his own death.
